description_en: Invoke the SaveWebRtcInfo API to report WebRTC call status information from the agent side, including call quality monitoring data, for backend statistics and monitoring. Customers do not need to concern themselves with this API
description_zh: 调用SaveWebRtcInfo上报座席端WebRTC的通话状态信息，包括通话质量监控数据等，用于后台统计和监控，客户无需关心该接口
kebab_example: aliyun ccc save-web-rtc-info --instance-id ccc-test --call-id e13c9740-1e37-123b-21b6-00163e352f9 --job-id job-b8b0ca63-330c-4e65-8ae3-9de2c7ce7683 --content-type 4 --content media_source_:_,_remote_inbound_rtp_:_,_outbound_rtp_:_,_inbound_rtp_:_,_remote_outbound_rtp_:_,_candidate_:_,_basic_:_callId_:_e13c9740-1e37-123b-21b6-00163e352f9_,_timestamp_:_1647262108395_,_callStartTime_:_1647262108393_,_uid_:_user-test_,_access_point_:_shanghai_,_browser_:_90_,_ip_:_127.0.0.1 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SaveWebRtcInfo

parameters.help_en: The CallId of the call channel, generated by the SIP protocol. Each SIP call has a unique CallId
parameters.help_zh: 话务通道的CallId，有SIP协议生成，每个SIP通话都有一个CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The reporting content. The value comes from the voice transmission quality data obtained via rtcPeerConnection.getStats(selector) in the frontend WebRTC. This parameter is used only on the public cloud platform of Cloud Contact Center and does not require attention from integration customers
parameters.help_zh: 上报内容，值来自前端WebRTC中rtcPeerConnection.getStats(selector)获取的语音传输质量数据，只在云联络中心的公有云平台中使用，集成客户无需关心
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The reporting content information. This parameter is used only on the public cloud platform of Cloud Contact Center and does not require attention from integration customers
parameters.help_zh: 上报内容信息，只在云联络中心的公有云平台中使用，集成客户无需关心
parameters.name: content

RowCount.description_en: The number of rows returned upon data storage, indicating how many records were successfully written. If this value is not 1, an abnormal condition may have occurred and requires attention
RowCount.description_zh: 信息入库返回的行数，表示成功写入多少条记录，如果不为1，可能有异常，需要关注

TimeStamp.description_en: The time when the information was stored, formatted as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
TimeStamp.description_zh: 信息入库时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
